coverage.finding: Ink page number '28' with superscript 'b' and a point, top-left. The candidate's '28ᵇ.' matches the image.

A single-line holding with a tick, the query 'Contn. of b.96(3)ᵇ?', the 'Begins:' incipit and 'n.d.:14:7: Beng.' followed by an arrow. The fol. 29 overview shows the same arrow and line end ('4:7: Beng←') crossing into the fol. 29 left margin near d.918(12)/e.155(8). That is the same text, not a new record. The final letter of 'sāpiṇḍam' could be read as '-n'/'-m'; the candidate already marks this as uncertain.

The initial 'V' has the same form as the ticks before fol. 29 shelfmarks (e.g. '√c. 384 (6)'). Reading it as a tick plus 'c.439ᵃ' is reasonable, and the candidate keeps it uncertain. The double-headed arrow at the gutter is noted.

Two-line entry. The title ending looks like '-vivaraṇe' (n with an underdot followed by e) rather than '-vivaraṇa'. The candidate literal gives '-vivaraṇa' while flagging the doubt, so a change is proposed. The 'p'l of' abbreviation is kept as uncertain. A connector line runs to the fol. 29 arrow near c.245(2)/d.582(4).

The owner name after 'ff.1-45,' is cursive, and the candidate's bracketed uncertain reading is appropriate. The final 'D' runs into a stroke or line toward the gutter; 'Dt' versus 'D' plus a flourish is unresolved. The line reaches fol. 29 near √d.136(5) Upanayanapaddhati. The fol. 29 overview shows the same line end ('n.d.45:7:D').
Smaller interlinear line directly under b005, beginning with an unclear '+ or'/'for'-like form. Its attachment to r005 is supported by position.
The note is preceded by a dash. 'sūtra' may be written without a visible macron; this is a minor point. The arrow at the gutter is noted. Its attachment to √d.128(4) on fol. 29 is by height only.

'ff1-16, not L, II, 709.' with an arrow from the gutter. The arrow height corresponds to √d.860(3) on fol. 29, but fol. 29's d.128(4) also reads 'ff.1-16'. The target remains ambiguous, as the candidate notes.
